newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon sells property for HK$200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon sells property for HK$200 mln.

text.p: Flour and edible oils wholesaler and distributor Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd said on Friday it has agreed to sell an industrial property in Hong Kong's Kwun Tong to third party Pioneer Dragon Ltd for HK$200 million.
Lam Soon said it is also entitled to 20 percent of the net profits arising upon sale of individual units in the new building which is to be redeveloped by the buyer.

The property, comprises a 9-storey purpose-built flour mill building and related facilties covering a site area of 24,370 sq. ft., is intended to be redeveloped for office and commercial purposes, the statement said.
Lam Soon said proceeds from sale of property and profit arising from the property redevelopment would be used to repay outstanding bank borrowings.
Lam Soon shares rose HK$0.09 or 16.98 percent to HK$0.62 in late morning on volume of 672,000 shares.
